comment: v2 spec §3.2 seasonal material palettes; backdrop (the land beyond the data) from the lighting bible look-fix-v1 §4: #A9B4A0 summer, #BDC8D4 winter (sRGB authoring colors; interpolate in linear light). Order: spring, summer, autumn, winter. House colors are season-independent and live in the regional profiles. Context-ring masses (look-fix-v1 §4, land seen from beyond the detailed area): residential = linear-light mix of 28% roof #606368, 30% lawn, 27% deciduous, 15% road/sidewalk; commercial = 45% flat roof #73746F, 40% parking, 15% green; wood = deciduous/conifer canopy (75/25) x0.86; farmland hand-set muted crop/stubble/soil. lawnA/lawnB: lot lawn endpoint pair (look-fix-v1 §1.1, North Shore defaults); a scene overrides them from its area profile's yards.json lawnEndpoints; renderers mix base = mix(lawnA, lawnB, extra.y). Tree crown slots deciduous1-8, conifer1-2 and bark: the chicago region of vegetation.json (vegetation-v1 species colours: deciduous1 linden, 2 maple, 3 oak, 4 elm, 5-8 the spreading family oak/elm/honey locust/oak; conifers spruce; bare winter = branch colour); a scene replaces them with its profile's region (vegetation.json). deciduous5-8 are appended after the context-ring masses so earlier slots keep their indices. crownColors: per crown form (profile crownWeights keys) the first slot and how many consecutive slots (1, 2 or 4) its trees pick from per instance.
